assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visible-light photoredox catalysis turned single-electron transfer from excited-state metal complexes and organic dyes into a general, mild tool for bond construction. It reshaped synthetic planning and is used widely in pharmaceutical and materials chemistry.
assessment.attribution: MacMillan (with dual-catalysis concepts), Yoon and Stephenson independently launched the modern synthetic field in 2008-2009. Credit is crowded (Konig, Nicewicz, Melchiorre, Fukuzumi); a three-person cap forces painful omissions.
assessment.maturity: More than fifteen years of independent confirmation, industrial uptake and a mature mechanistic picture. Timely.
uncertainties: MacMillan was recognised in 2021 for organocatalysis; the committee may view overlap as a drawback.
Priority relative to earlier photochemistry of Kellogg, Deronzier and others is not something I can verify here.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rational design of zeolites and molecular-sieve catalysts with controlled pore architecture and active sites underpins refining, petrochemistry and emissions control (e.g. SSZ-13 for NOx). Structure determines function here, and structure determination by diffraction and electron crystallography was central to progress.
assessment.attribution: Corma (broad catalyst design and industrial processes), Davis (new frameworks and catalytic design) and Zones (SSZ-13 and organic structure-directing agents) are plausible. Yu, Tsapatsis and others made major contributions, so allocation is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Decades of established industrial practice and independent confirmation. Recognition would be timely, with no earlier prize for zeolite catalysis.
uncertainties: Several equal contributors; the discovery is a body of work rather than one invention.
I have a field-specific interest and should weigh peers' views for balance.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Mesoporous nanocrystalline TiO2 sensitised with molecular dyes achieved efficient photoelectrochemical solar conversion, opening a major route in molecular photovoltaics and inspiring perovskite photovoltaics. The original 1991 concept is clear and has lasting impact.
assessment.attribution: Grätzel is the clear intellectual leader. O’Regan was the co-author of the decisive 1991 Nature paper; Hagfeldt contributed later developments and is a less decisive choice for the original discovery.
assessment.maturity: Over thirty years of follow-up; efficiencies and stability have been confirmed independently, though commercial impact is modest.
uncertainties: Commercial impact limited compared with silicon; the committee may favour perovskites or the broader field instead.
A two-person prize may be seen as too narrow.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase structures resolved the FeMo-cofactor, including the interstitial carbide and substrate-bound states, grounding the mechanism of biological nitrogen fixation. This is a crisp structural chemistry problem with agricultural and environmental implications.
assessment.attribution: Rees led the founding crystal structures; Einsle established the central carbide and high-resolution work; Dean gave the genetic and biochemical basis. Seefeldt, Ribbe and others also contributed, so credit is shared and unresolved.
assessment.maturity: Structural evidence is strong and independently corroborated; the catalytic mechanism of N2 reduction is still incompletely resolved, so recognition may be slightly early.
uncertainties: Whether a prize should honour structure alone while the mechanism remains partly open.
Choice between Dean and Seefeldt or Ribbe for the biochemical side is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Discovery and synthesis of carbon nanotubes created a new class of nanomaterial. Iijima’s high-resolution electron microscopy established the multi-walled tubes’ structure, and single-walled tubes opened a vast materials field.
assessment.attribution: Iijima clearly made the 1991 discovery; Iijima and Bethune independently reported single-walled tubes in 1993. Endo’s earlier work and prior reports of hollow carbon fibres complicate priority.
assessment.maturity: Thirty-plus years of confirmation; applications have been slower than predicted, but the scientific significance is established.
uncertainties: Priority disputes over earlier carbon filaments.
Chemistry versus physics framing, and fullerenes were already recognised in 1996.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Halide perovskite absorbers delivered an unprecedented rise in solar-cell efficiency in a few years, with a novel defect-tolerant crystalline semiconductor family. The impact is large and rapidly growing.
assessment.attribution: Miyasaka first reported perovskite-sensitised cells, Park produced the solid-state device, and Snaith made the efficient thin-film devices. Grätzel, Seok and Kanatzidis also have strong claims, so attribution is crowded.
assessment.maturity: Stability and lead toxicity remain unresolved and long-term commercial confirmation is limited, so timing may be premature.
uncertainties: Long-term stability and scalability are not established.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Template-directed ordered mesoporous silica (M41S, FSM-16) introduced liquid-crystal templating to create uniform mesopores, opening porous materials with tunable architecture for catalysis, adsorption, and later templating of nanomaterials.
assessment.attribution: Kresge and Beck (Mobil) reported M41S; Inagaki’s FSM-16 was parallel and arguably earlier; Ryoo extended to ordered mesoporous carbons and other materials. Stucky and Zhao (SBA-15) are also credible, so credit is divided.
assessment.maturity: Well established over thirty years; many independent confirmations. Industrial impact is moderate.
uncertainties: Impact is mostly enabling rather than transformative.
Disputed priority between Mobil and Japanese groups.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation reframes drug action by inducing proximity between a target and an E3 ligase, and the cereblon mechanism of thalidomide analogues is a significant chemical and biological explanation.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies launched PROTACs; Ciulli provided structure-guided VHL ligands; Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target. Gray, Ito and others also contributed, so allocation is complex.
assessment.maturity: Clinical validation is still emerging; the concept is confirmed across many laboratories but approvals of PROTACs are limited, so this may be early.
uncertainties: Several close claimants for the molecular-glue part.
